name: @suite/help-pack
description: Help's pack source and its build. The Electron shell stays in legacy/help.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../../legacy/help index && pnpm --dir ../../legacy/help sync && vite build --config pack/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --dir ../../legacy/help index && pnpm --dir ../../legacy/help sync && vitest run --config pack/vitest.config.mts
